blocks.en: Blowup of Smooth Solutions
blocks.zh: 光滑解的爆破
blocks.label: sec:conservation-smooth-blowup

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: As we noted above, the main purpose of this chapter is to study PDEs with discontinuous solutions. We are now prepared to show how discontinuous solutions of conservation laws can develop from continuous ones.
blocks.zh: 如上所述, 本章的主要目的是研究具有不连续解的偏微分方程. 现在已做好准备, 可以说明守恒律的不连续解如何由连续解发展而来.

blocks.en: Single Conservation Laws
blocks.zh: 单个守恒律
blocks.label: subsec:scalar-conservation-blowup

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points
visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: As a result of this relation we get the following very strong result for single conservation laws.
blocks.zh: 由这一关系, 可对单个守恒律得到以下很强的结果.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Any $C^1$ solution of the single conservation law \eqref{eq:scalar-conservation-law-quasilinear} is constant along characteristics. Accordingly, characteristic curves for \eqref{eq:scalar-conservation-law-quasilinear} are straight lines.
blocks.zh: 单个守恒律 \eqref{eq:scalar-conservation-law-quasilinear} 的任意 $C^1$ 解沿特征线为常数. 因而, 方程 \eqref{eq:scalar-conservation-law-quasilinear} 的特征曲线是直线.
blocks.label: thm:scalar-constant-characteristics

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points
visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Defining a solution by characteristics.
blocks.zh: 通过特征线定义解.
blocks.label: fig:characteristic-construction

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points
visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Thus, the initial data give us the slopes of the characteristic rays emanating from the $x$ axis. For certain initial data this gives us a method for "solving" the Cauchy problem. We simply go along the $x$ axis, drawing characteristic rays with slope depending on the initial data, and let the solution take the value of the corresponding initial data along the characteristic (cf. Figure~\ref{fig:characteristic-construction}).
blocks.zh: 因此, 初始数据给出了从 $x$ 轴出发的特征射线的斜率. 对某些初始数据, 这就给出一种"求解" Cauchy 问题的方法. 只需沿 $x$ 轴, 按初始数据决定的斜率画出特征射线, 并令解沿特征线取相应初始数据的值 (参见 Figure~\ref{fig:characteristic-construction}).

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Unfortunately, some simple examples of discontinuous initial data show us just how easily the procedure falls apart. In Figure~\ref{fig:characteristic-gap} we see that for an initial condition corresponding to a step function, there is a region that is untouched by any characteristics from the initial data; the procedure above does not identify a solution in this region. As we shall see below, in this case we will be able to identify a continuous solution called a rarefaction or fan wave.
blocks.zh: 可惜, 一些不连续初始数据的简单例子表明, 这一过程很容易失效. Figure~\ref{fig:characteristic-gap} 显示, 对应于阶跃函数的初始条件, 存在一个区域, 从初始数据出发的任何特征线都未经过它; 上述过程不能确定这一区域内的解. 如下文将看到的, 在这种情形下可以确定一个连续解, 称为稀疏波或扇形波.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: However, in Figure~\ref{fig:characteristic-overlap} we have a more difficult problem. For a decreasing step function the characteristics overlap. Since our solution cannot be multivalued, we must conclude (in light of Theorem~\ref{thm:scalar-constant-characteristics}) that it cannot be smooth. For this type of initial data we will have to develop a theory of discontinuous solutions, or "shock waves."
blocks.zh: 然而, Figure~\ref{fig:characteristic-overlap} 中的问题更为困难. 对递减的阶跃函数, 特征线相互交叠. 由于解不能是多值的, 必须得出结论 (根据 Theorem~\ref{thm:scalar-constant-characteristics}): 解不可能光滑. 对这种初始数据, 必须发展不连续解, 即"激波"的理论.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points
visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Characteristics do not specify the solution in the blank region.
blocks.zh: 特征线不能确定空白区域内的解.
blocks.label: fig:characteristic-gap

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Characteristics overlap.
blocks.zh: 特征线相互交叠.
blocks.label: fig:characteristic-overlap

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Note that smoothing out the data does not help matters in this case; it merely delays the problem. In fact, the following theorem shows that the problem of overlapping characteristics and the development of singularities is a generic problem.
blocks.zh: 注意, 在这种情形下将数据光滑化也无济于事; 这只是推迟了问题的出现. 事实上, 以下定理表明, 特征线交叠和奇性的形成是一个普遍的问题.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Intersecting characteristics from continuous initial data.
blocks.zh: 从连续初始数据出发的特征线相交.
blocks.label: fig:continuous-characteristic-crossing

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: If $f''>0$ and the initial data $u_0$ is not monotone increasing, then the Cauchy problem for \eqref{eq:scalar-conservation-law-quasilinear} does not have a $C^1$ solution defined on the entire upper half-plane $(x,t)\in(-\infty,\infty)\times[0,\infty)$.
blocks.zh: 若 $f''>0$, 且初始数据 $u_0$ 不是单调递增的, 则方程 \eqref{eq:scalar-conservation-law-quasilinear} 的 Cauchy 问题不存在定义在整个上半平面 $(x,t)\in(-\infty,\infty)\times[0,\infty)$ 上的 $C^1$ 解.
blocks.label: thm:scalar-finite-time-blowup

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The proof simply depends on the observation that if $f'(u_0(x_1))>f'(u_0(x_2))$, for $x_1<x_2$, the characteristics emanating from $x_1$ and $x_2$ will intersect in finite time (cf. Figure~\ref{fig:continuous-characteristic-crossing}).
blocks.zh: 证明仅依赖于如下观察: 若对 $x_1<x_2$ 有 $f'(u_0(x_1))>f'(u_0(x_2))$, 则从 $x_1$ 和 $x_2$ 出发的特征线将在有限时间内相交 (参见 Figure~\ref{fig:continuous-characteristic-crossing}).

blocks.en: Using this and the calculations above, we can show
blocks.zh: 利用这一结果和上面的计算, 可证明

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
Assume that
\[
\sup_{x_1,x_2\in\mathbb{R}}\hat\lambda'(\rho_1(x_1,0)-\rho_2(x_2,0))<0
\]
and that
\[
m:=\max[\sup_xr(x,0),\sup_xs(x,0)]>0.
\]
Let
\[
\begin{aligned}
A&:=-\inf_{x_1,x_2\in\mathbb{R}}\hat\lambda^{-1/2}\hat\lambda'(\rho_1(x_1,0)-\rho_2(x_2,0)),\\
B&:=-\sup_{x_1,x_2\in\mathbb{R}}\hat\lambda^{-1/2}\hat\lambda'(\rho_1(x_1,0)-\rho_2(x_2,0)).
\end{aligned}
\]
Then at least one of $r$ and $s$ becomes unbounded at a time between $(mA)^{-1}$ and $(mB)^{-1}$.
blocks.zh:
假设
\[
\sup_{x_1,x_2\in\mathbb{R}}\hat\lambda'(\rho_1(x_1,0)-\rho_2(x_2,0))<0
\]
且
\[
m:=\max[\sup_xr(x,0),\sup_xs(x,0)]>0.
\]
令
\[
\begin{aligned}
A&:=-\inf_{x_1,x_2\in\mathbb{R}}\hat\lambda^{-1/2}\hat\lambda'(\rho_1(x_1,0)-\rho_2(x_2,0)),\\
B&:=-\sup_{x_1,x_2\in\mathbb{R}}\hat\lambda^{-1/2}\hat\lambda'(\rho_1(x_1,0)-\rho_2(x_2,0)).
\end{aligned}
\]
那么 $r$ 和 $s$ 至少有一个在 $(mA)^{-1}$ 与 $(mB)^{-1}$ 之间的某个时刻变为无界.
blocks.label: thm:p-system-finite-time-blowup

blocks.en: The proof of this theorem and Lemma~\ref{lem:riccati-finite-time-blowup} are left to the reader as exercises.
blocks.zh: 本定理和 Lemma~\ref{lem:riccati-finite-time-blowup} 的证明留给读者作为练习.
